title: Wings — Lower Cover Stringer Run-Outs Ribs 8 to 14 — Ultrasonic Survey, VANTOR-68

ata.title: Wing Box Structure — Lower Cover Panels

abstract: Mandatory repeat ultrasonic survey of the lower cover stringer run-outs between ribs 8 and 14 on the four-engine stretched aircraft, required until the reinforcement is embodied.

sections.planning_reason: Revised fatigue evidence for the four-engine stretched aircraft places the crack initiation life of the lower cover stringer run-outs between 44 000 and 51 000 flight cycles, well short of the 60 000 assumed at certification. One aircraft has already produced a 9 mm indication at the rib 11 run-out. Until the reinforcement is embodied the only means of compliance is a repeat inspection, and the authority has made it mandatory through an airworthiness directive. The affected population is small but several aircraft are already close to the threshold.
sections.description: An ultrasonic survey of the run-out region of stringers 12 through 18 is made from inside the tank between ribs 8 and 14, on both wings. Indications are sized and reported. Aircraft with no indication continue at the repeat interval; aircraft with an indication inside the reportable size are subject to a shortened interval; aircraft above it are grounded pending an engineering assessment.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-fuel the aircraft and purge the tank to the standard practice for tank entry. WARNING: do not enter the tank until the atmosphere test is complete and recorded. Get access through the tank access panels in zones 531, 541 and 591. Clean the run-out region of stringers 12 to 18 between ribs 8 and 14 and remove any sealant that hides the last three fastener rows. Do the ultrasonic survey of AMM-S-57-10-12-200-007-A over the run-out region of each stringer, recording the response at each fastener. Size any indication and record its position by stringer and by fastener number. Restore the sealant over the surveyed area. Close the tank and do the leak check. Report the result to Aeralis within ten days whether or not an indication is found.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all VTR-68R2 aircraft that have not been brought to the reinforced lower cover standard. Aircraft that have embodied the reinforcement are released from this inspection and from the associated airworthiness directive. The twin-engine and shorter four-engine variants carry a different bending spectrum and are not affected.
sections.material_note: No kit is required. Tank entry consumables and sealant for restoration are the only material. The ultrasonic equipment must be at the calibration standard given in the accomplishment instructions; a reference block is available from Aeralis on loan.

type_data.compliance_time: Before 38 000 flight cycles or within 1 500 flight cycles after the effective date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs later, and thereafter at intervals not exceeding 4 000 flight cycles.
